description.value: Executive Hotel Le Soleil is a boutique luxury property in downtown Vancouver that opened in 1999 and has held AAA Diamond recognition while ranking among Canada's top 25 most luxurious hotels. All 113 suites are styled with 18th-century Parisian decor paired with modern amenities, and the on-site Alouette Bistro offers French-inspired dining. Its central Hornby Street location places arriving cyclists steps from the city's waterfront, transit, and surrounding neighbourhoods.
